note: Median door-to-door minutes by Muni or walking, whichever is faster, on SFMTA's late-August 2026 schedule (GTFS calendar 2026-07-23 to 2026-08-28, departures 2026-08-26 8:00 to 8:59 AM), from each populated 2020 census block's street frontage (its fastest origin in data/full-map/transit-origins.json) to the nearest destination point of each type; whole minutes, rounded down; null past max_minutes.

end_to_end_min.why: Sunnydale to Chinatown in about 35 minutes (the feed's peak trips take 45 to 48), roughly what full signal priority would give

headway_min.why: a T every 5 minutes all day, both directions (the feed runs every 10 in the AM peak)

pattern.value: every trip full length; the feed's short turns removed

scaling.why: every stop-to-stop time and dwell scaled by end_to_end_min over the template's duration

span.value: the feed's first to last T departure that day, per direction

spec.note: SFMTA's GTFS with route T's trips on 2026-08-26 replaced (scripts/full-map-gtfs-tthird.py). Every number under assumptions is a scenario assumption, not a measurement.

walk_only.note: R5's walk-only minutes over the same origins and network, per block in blocks' order: a block's Muni trip is real only where blocks' minutes are below these.
